name: dTelecom
description: Speech and realtime voice infrastructure for agents: speech-to-text at $0.006/min across 99+ languages, text-to-speech at $0.008/1K chars, and WebRTC audio at $0.001/participant-min. Agents buy microcredits with USDC over x402 on Base or Solana, with no API key or account.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: No API keys, no accounts. Payment is a CREDIT PURCHASE, not per-call: POST https://x402.dtelecom.org/v1/credits/purchase returns 402 with USDC requirements for Base (eip155:8453) and Solana and a body taking wallet_address, wallet_chain and amount_usd (minimum $0.10); the credited microcredits then fund STT/TTS/WebRTC calls. MPP (USDC on Tempo) and USDT on TRON are also offered. MCP server: https://github.com/dTelecom/stt-mcp
